title: Power Rankings: Nuggets, Mavs lead wild West
heading: 2004-05 Power Rankings: Week 23

rankings.summaryHtml: Dare we say it's safe to anoint Denver as the proverbial Lower Seed No One Wants To Play. Nuggets are now  a ridiculous 21-0 since Feb. 23 . . . if you exclude two losses to Phoenix.

rankings.summaryHtml: Mavs are becoming a trendy pick to make playoff noise, but more impressive is how steady they've become. This is a fifth straight 50-win season, after just two in the club's first 20 years.
